verdict.rationale: The pack offers only indirect support. Search analytics captures real traffic signals such as popular searches (algolia-docs-9). Community users describe instant, as-you-type results through DocSearch and a drop-in JS input (algolia-comm-5, algolia-comm-15). InstantSearch allows custom widgets (algolia-docs-35), so a developer could plausibly assemble suggestions from these pieces, but nothing documents a dedicated query-suggestions or autocomplete capability. missing for 10: documented query-suggestions feature or suggestions index, an autocomplete widget/library, a mechanism that generates suggestions from analytics data, and hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality.
